title: MZ Making a Menu like Dragon Quest/Earthbound

posts.author: overlordmikey
posts.body:
First) Hello, long time no see. Yes I am alive.
Second or "getting to the point") So I'm working on a game and it's meant to be somewhat old school, but I've never been to good with changing what the menu looks like in RPG Maker (let alone MV, which I haven't used much).
As much as I would LOVE to put together a menu by carefully learning the coding myself - I also have to make all the resources for this game and I'm fairly new to pixel art.
I was hoping to make the menu look similar to old school Dragon Quest or Earthbound menu style. It doesn't have to have the exact same options - just style.
Any idea how I'd go about doing that - if someone has done something similar already and is willing to share that would be even better. I've got a lot on my plate right now and any help would be great.
(Wasn't sure if this was the right section, um if someone could move it if it's wrong that would be wonderful - thank you.)

posts.author: Kenen
posts.body:
If you Google "rpg maker mz dragon quest menu," you'll get at least one GitHub hit for a plugin. At a quick glance, it looks like a fairly limited plugin and has no screenshots, but it might get you started.
Otherwise, your request has a sliding complexity scale.
You can easily get the Dragon Quest "style" by changing the menu background to an unfiltered snapshot of the map, which would give you the style of the menu being overlaid directly on the map.
From there, you can get increasingly more complex depending on how much you want to emulate the menu layout and system, as RPG Maker uses discrete scenes and layouts for most of the menu options whereas Dragon Quest uses a more seamless, overlapping menu design.
But, as
@ATT_Turan
says, you haven't really specified what you want.
If you're looking for minor changes I might be willing to help out, as long as you aren't using VisuStella.
